title: DollJoint Solo #053 (하늘색 킨츠기 · 보라 관절 · 체형 super hourglass · 인종 Polynesian · 메이크업 걸크러시(강화) · 배경 플라네타륨 로비 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, top bun copper red hair — full body glazed pale-blue ceramic ball-jointed doll mended with gold fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid glazed ceramic body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into smooth fitted ceramic segments, and at her neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles every segment ends in a round exposed ball joint seated in its socket with a thin dark gap and its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted segments — BLAZING glossy pale sky-blue glaze across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID glossy deep violet lacquer ball joints standing out sharply against the pale blue, bright gold kintsugi seams zigzagging across every segment, high-gloss glazed, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same glazed ceramic, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each longer than her middle finger, made of the same glazed ceramic with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a gold belly chain with a small pendant resting on her belly plate, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the doll body — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Background: a bright planetarium lobby with a polished pale floor, a curved white wall, a standard-height door and a low step, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
